message.reasoning_content:
The watch is a Cartier Tank Solo (or Tank Must). Roman numerals, rectangular case, blue sword hands, cabochon crown. The dial appears to say "Automatic" below the Cartier logo — that suggests Tank Solo Automatic, reference W5200025 (steel large model on leather strap) or the Tank Must Large WSTA0041. Actually Tank Solo automatic steel large is W5200025 (ref 3800). The Tank Must 2021 WSTA0041 has "Automatic" text? Tank Must large steel has "Automatic" printed on dial and reference WSTA0041. Hmm.

The Tank Solo Large Automatic (steel, leather strap) reference is W5200025. The Tank Must large steel WSTA0041 also has "Automatic" on dial. Both look nearly identical. The image seems older-ish; Tank Solo has a slightly thicker case and a flat crown with blue cabochon. Tank Must has a blue cabochon too.

Let me guess W5200025 with modest confidence. Case steel, bracelet leather, movement automatic.

Model family: Tank Solo (Cartier Tank).

Confidence ~0.35.
